Dates: the legs carry no per-run stamp; 2026-09-28 is the session date (FINDINGS/NOTES header, the g2 full log's own epoch 1790547879 = 2026-09-28 07:24 JST, out/ mtimes 06:59-07:27 JST, all before the 09:12 JST Hub upload).
